answer: Miscellaneous >> Tasawwuf Question ID: 36937 Country: Bangladesh Title: Is it necessary to catch peer and is it fardh, wajib, sunnat or nafl Question: Is it necessary to catch peer and is it fardh, wajib, sunnat or nafl? Answer ID: 36937 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 439/353/D=1433) To catch the hand of peer means to establish relation of reformation with any ideal Shaikh and to have baiah with him. So it is wajib to establish such relation while getting baiah is sunnah and mustahab. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
